newsitem.title: USA: Houston Industries says investors choose.
newsitem.headline: Houston Industries says investors choose.

text.p: Houston Industries Inc said Wednesday preliminary results show 103.3 million shares of NorAm Energy Corp elected to take cash as opposed to 37.1 million shares electing to take stock in connection with the closing of Houston's purchase of NorAm.
Currently, Houston Industries estimates the preliminary cash proration factor would be between .8 and .85, the company said in a statement.
At the election deadline of 1700 EST/2200 GMT New York time on Tuesday Aug 5, Houston Industries said there were roughly 149.7 million shares outstanding.
Houston Industries also said the total number of NorAm shares converted into cash will not be determined until the end of trading Wednesday.
